selection_policy: Use every eligible source pair before model evaluation. Keep all failures and truncations in the report. Do not tune protocol from test results.

protocol.assignment: Index modulo 5 in the cohort's fixed seed-17 SHA256-ranked repository-component ledger
protocol.encoder: Reuse the frozen, label-independent CodeBERT vectors on identical original code; refit every classifier and lexical vocabulary within each fold
protocol.threshold: Select separately on each fold's validation repositories; never on that fold's test repositories
protocol.primary_measure: Mean balanced accuracy across all 40 out-of-fold repository components
protocol.pooling_rule: Pool fold-specific decisions, not classification thresholds or cross-fold ranking scores
protocol.selection_policy: No fold, data source or model is selected by test performance. Publish all five folds, all six models and one held-out prediction per original example.
